notes.title: Small Fixes and QOL Changes 4/12/2024
notes.content:
- Added force respawn by holding R (B or Circle on controller).
- Clouds immediately reset dash/double-jump when hit.
- Players are no longer locked in place at the end podium.
- The campfire area has been added to the podium.
- Reduced lighting glitches by far away objects.
- Lowered ambient occlusion.

notes.title: Ball Boys Update!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41584650/48bcbe0df0ab6247ebb3894bb2c22fffe392186e.png[/img]
[h2]Additions:[/h2]
[list]
[*]New menu song by Cetch called "#9fe2bf"
[*]PostProcessing[list]

[*]Icospheres

[*]Prisms

[/list][*]You can now change your skybox in the menu or in-game.

[/list]

+ the main menu scene now has a nice campfire :)

notes.title: Various bug fixes - December 22, 2021
notes.content:
Fixes:
- Player positions are now linearly extrapolating in combination with interpolating.
	(unless there's lag, other players' positions should be more accurate)
- Settings are now increased/decreased at a 1% interval as opposed to 5% intervals.
- Chat message of "Player Finished!" is no longer clipping off the screen.
- Title screen's "About" section resizes properly with varying displays.
- Slight change to view of Multiplayer screen to give a better view of the player.
- Internal verbosity and netcode changes.
